title: Rotational Kinetic Energy of the Earth
body: Model the Earth as a uniform solid sphere of mass $$5.97\times10**{24}\,\text{kg}$$ and radius $$6.37\times10**{6}\,\text{m}$$ $$(I=(2/5)MR**{2})$$. $$It$$ $$spins$$ $$once$$ $$per$$ $$day$$ ($$8.64\times10**{4}\,\text{s}$$) $$and$$ $$orbits$$ $$the$$ $$Sun$$ $$once$$ $$per$$ $$year$$ ($$3.156\times10**{7}\,\text{s}$$) $$at$$ $$an$$ $$orbital$$ $$radius$$ $$of$$ $$1.50\times10**{11}\,\text{m}$$.
